svg.title: Pitchfork: two graphical halves joined along a vertical line
svg.desc: Original schematic for half-width pi, reflected to upward translation. Teal and ochre halves form one smooth surface. Not a solved translator. Artificial window edges are shown.

g.text: Hoffman–Martín–White, Figures 6 and 14, Theorem 12.1. This drawing does not solve the translator equation.
